name: 3D Gaussian Cloud Generation
definition: Algorithm for cumulus generation using a 3D Gaussian distribution of basic pseudo-spheroid primitives. Uses clamping for position generation similar to Huang et al. [1], but requires significantly fewer primitives (typically 35) compared to particle systems (thousands).
summary: 3D Gaussian Cloud Generation creates realistic clouds using sparse, explicit pseudo-spheroids, requiring fewer primitives than particle systems and optimizing performance via pre-processing filters.
